description_en: Queries the backup tasks of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的备份任务列表
name: DescribeBackupTasks

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length. It cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup task
parameters.name: backup_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup pattern. Valid values:
Automated: automatic backup
Manual: manual backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup task. Valid values:
NoStart: not started
Progressing: in progress

Default value: all statuses
parameters.help_zh:
备份任务状态，取值：
NoStart：未开始
Progressing：正在进行中

默认为所有状态
parameters.name: backup_job_status

items.description_en: The details of the backup task

BackupId.description_en:
The ID of the backup set generated by the task.
You can view the backup set ID only when the BackupJobId request parameter is specified and the BackupStatus response parameter is returned as Finished
BackupId.description_zh:
任务生成的备份集ID。
当返回参数BackupStatus为Finished后，传入请求参数BackupJobId才能够查看到备份集ID

BackupJobId.description_en: The ID of the backup task

BackupProgressStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup program. Valid values:
NoStart: not started
Preparing: preparing
Waiting: waiting
Uploading: uploading
Checking: checking
Finished: completed
BackupProgressStatus.description_zh:
备份程序状态。取值：
NoStart：未开始
Preparing：准备中
Waiting：等待中
Uploading：上传中
Checking：检查中
Finished：已完成

BackupStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup task. Valid values:
NoStart: not started
Checking: checking the backup
Preparing: preparing the backup
Waiting: waiting for the backup
Uploading: uploading the backup
Finished: backup completed
Failed: backup failed

This parameter is returned only when a task is being executed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份任务状态。取值：
NoStart：未开始
Checking：检查备份
Preparing：准备备份
Waiting：等待备份
Uploading：上传备份
Finished：完成备份
Failed：备份失败

有任务执行时才会返回本参数

JobMode.description_en:
The backup pattern. Valid values:
Automated: automatic backup
Manual: manual backup
JobMode.description_zh:
备份模式，取值：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

Process.description_en: The progress percentage of the task

TaskAction.description_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:
TempBackupTask: temporary backup task
NormalBackupTask: regular backup task
TaskAction.description_zh:
任务类型，取值：
TempBackupTask：临时备份任务
NormalBackupTask：普通备份任务
